CredentialProviderConfig.description_en: The configuration of the credential provider

JwtProviderConfig.description_en: The configuration of the JWT credential provider
JwtProviderConfig.description_zh: JWT类型的凭据提供商配置

AllowedTokenIssuers.description_en: The list of allowed JWT issuers

DerivedShortTokenEnabled.description_en: Specifies whether to enable the JWT derived short token capability
DerivedShortTokenEnabled.description_zh: 是否开启JWT派生短令牌能力
DerivedShortTokenEnabled.title_en: 是否开启JWT派生短令牌能力。
DerivedShortTokenEnabled.title_zh: 是否开启JWT派生短令牌能力。

Expiration.description_en: The validity period of the JWT. Unit: seconds

ExpirationCleanupEnabled.description_en: Specifies whether to enable JWT expiration cleanup

OAuthProviderConfig.description_en: The configuration of the OAuth credential provider
OAuthProviderConfig.description_zh: OAuth类型的凭据提供商配置

AuthorizationEndpoint.description_en: The endpoint address used to guide users through authorization. This parameter is conditionally required: it is required when AuthorizationFlow is set to user_federation and ProviderVendor is set to custom. For preset vendors, this value can be automatically populated through DiscoveryUrl
AuthorizationEndpoint.description_zh: 用于引导用户进行授权的端点地址。条件必填：当AuthorizationFlow=user_federation且ProviderVendor=custom时必填；预置厂商可通过DiscoveryUrl自动填充

AuthorizationFlow.description_en: The OAuth authorization flow type. Valid values: m2m: machine-to-machine (2LO, Client Credentials). user_federation: user federation (3LO, Authorization Code)
AuthorizationFlow.description_zh: OAuth的具体授权类型。m2m: 机器对机器(2LO, Client Credentials)；user_federation: 用户联邦(3LO, Authorization Code)

ClientId.description_en: The client_id in the OAuth protocol

DiscoveryUrl.description_en: The URL of the discovery document used to automatically obtain OAuth endpoint configurations. This parameter is conditionally optional: it is used when AuthorizationFlow is set to user_federation. If DiscoveryUrl is not provided, you must manually configure fields such as TokenEndpoint and AuthorizationEndpoint
DiscoveryUrl.description_zh: 用于自动获取OAuth端点配置的Discovery文档地址。条件可选：当AuthorizationFlow=user_federation时使用，如不提供DiscoveryUrl，则需手动配置TokenEndpoint、AuthorizationEndpoint等字段

PkceChallengeMethod.description_en: The PKCE code_challenge generation method. Default value: s256
PkceChallengeMethod.description_zh: PKCE code_challenge 生成方法。默认s256

PkceEnabled.description_en: Specifies whether to use the PKCE extension to enhance security. We recommend that you always enable this feature
PkceEnabled.description_zh: 是否使用PKCE扩展增强安全性，推荐始终启用

ProviderVendor.description_en: The preset vendor or custom configuration. This parameter is optional. Default value: custom
ProviderVendor.description_zh: 预置厂商或自定义配置。非必填，默认值：custom

Scope.description_en:
The scope in the OAuth protocol, which specifies the permission scope.

The scope configuration of the OAuth credential provider serves as the default value. If the scope parameter is not specified when calling the DeveloperAPI to obtain an OAuth access token, the scope configuration of the credential provider is used for token issuance.

<notice>Multiple scope values are separated by spaces.></notice>
Scope.description_zh:
对应OAuth协议中的scope，权限范围。

OAuth凭据提供商处的Scope配置将作为兜底值，若在调用DeveloperAPI获取OAuth Access Token时不指定scope参数，则会以凭据提供商处的Scope配置为准进行签发。

<notice>多个Scope值之间会通过空格分隔。></notice>

SystemRedirectUri.description_en: The redirect URI automatically generated by the system when the credential provider is created. Configure this value as the redirect_uri in the OAuth provider
SystemRedirectUri.description_zh: 创建凭据提供商时系统自动生成的重定向地址，需在OAuth提供商处配置为redirect_uri

TokenEndpoint.description_en: The token endpoint of the OAuth protocol

ProviderCredentialIds.description_en:
The list of credential IDs that correspond to the sensitive configurations of the credential provider.

The system securely stores the sensitive configuration information of the credential provider in the form of credentials
ProviderCredentialIds.description_zh:
凭据提供商的敏感配置对应的凭据ID列表。

系统会将凭据提供商的敏感配置信息以“凭据”的形式进行安全存储

items.description_en: The credential ID that corresponds to the sensitive configuration

ProviderCredentialIds.title_en: 凭据提供商的敏感配置对应的凭据ID列表。
ProviderCredentialIds.title_zh: 凭据提供商的敏感配置对应的凭据ID列表。

The creation type of the credential provider. Valid values:

system_init: Created by the system.
user_custom: Created by the user
CredentialProviderCreationType.description_zh:
凭据提供商创建类型。取值可选范围：

system_init：系统创建。
user_custom：用户创建
CredentialProviderCreationType.title_en: 凭据提供商的创建类型。
CredentialProviderCreationType.title_zh: 凭据提供商的创建类型。

CredentialProviderIdentifier.description_en: The business identifier of the credential provider
CredentialProviderIdentifier.title_en: 凭据提供商的业务标识。
CredentialProviderIdentifier.title_zh: 凭据提供商的业务标识。

CredentialProviderName.description_en: The name of the credential provider

CredentialProviderType.description_en:
The type of the credential provider. Valid values:

oauth: OAuth credential provider.
jwt: JWT credential provider
CredentialProviderType.description_zh:
凭据提供商类型。取值可选范围：

oauth：OAuth凭据提供商
jwt：JWT凭据提供商

Status.description_en:
The status of the credential provider. Valid values:

enabled: Enabled.
disabled: Disabled
Status.description_zh:
凭据提供商状态。取值可选范围：

enabled：启用。
disabled：禁用

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the credential provider was last updated. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
UpdateTime.description_zh: 凭据提供商的更新时间，Unix时间戳，单位毫秒
